inputs.original_text: South Dakota is right to treat citizenship as a basic part of voting in its own state elections. Senate Bill 175 is a limited safeguard: it applies only to new registrants and state elections. Protecting confidence in the ballot is part of responsible self-government, not an unreasonable demand. A state’s future should be decided by its citizens.
inputs.modified_text: South Dakota is right to make citizenship a basic requirement for voting in its own state elections. Senate Bill 175 is a measured safeguard, applying only to new registrants and state elections. A nation’s self-government depends on clear rules and public confidence in the ballot; the future of South Dakota should be decided by its citizens.
